title: Format R Code with Arity
text: Arity automatically reads nearest arity.toml, searching upward file’s directory format_file() working directory format_text(). search includes repository root stops contains .git file directory. Otherwise, continues filesystem root. example: project configuration found, ARITY_CONFIG can name fallback file. Configuration files merged, missing settings use built-defaults: line width 80, indentation width 2, automatic line endings. Explicit formatting arguments override selected configuration. config = FALSE ignores project fallback configuration. explicit path skips discovery fallback. Relative configuration paths use working directory. Invalid formatting configuration produces error changing source. Settings CLI operations, file exclusions linting, effect R package.
code: [format] line-width = 100 indent-width = 2 line-ending = "auto" format_file("R/example.R", line_width = 100) format_file("R/example.R", config = FALSE) format_file("R/example.R", config = "other.toml")

title: Format R source code — format_text
text: text non-missing character scalar containing valid UTF-8 R source code. Strings declared encoding converted UTF-8. line_width Maximum output line width, 1 1000. NULL uses configuration value, 80 unset. indent_width Number spaces per indentation level, 1 1000. NULL uses configuration value, 2 unset. line_ending Output line-ending policy. "auto" preserves style first source line ending, "lf" "crlf" force style, "native" uses current platform's convention. NULL uses configuration value, "auto" unset. roxygen_markdown Whether roxygen blocks without explicit @md @noMd directive parsed markdown mode. verify Whether verify syntax preservation, ordinary comment preservation, idempotence formatting. config TRUE discovers configuration automatically, FALSE ignores configuration files, nonempty character scalar names explicit configuration file. missing unreadable selected file error. path non-missing character scalar naming UTF-8 file. contents treated R source regardless file extension.

title: Format R source code — format_text
text: default, formatting uses nearest arity.toml, searching upward file's directory format_file() working directory format_text(). search includes repository root, stops .git file directory, filesystem root. project config found, nonempty ARITY_CONFIG environment variable supplies fallback config path. Relative explicit fallback paths use working directory. Configuration files merged. Missing settings use built-defaults, explicit formatting arguments override selected configuration. package reads line-width, indent-width, line-ending [format] table. Settings CLI operations, including exclusions, effect. Invalid formatting configuration raises error source changed.
